title: 左连接
objective: 保留所有顾客，为没有订单的顾客显示未匹配的 NULL。
statement: 输出全部顾客及其全部订单，不筛选订单状态。依次输出 customer_id、customer_name、order_id、status。每张匹配订单一行；没有订单的顾客也输出一行，order_id 和 status 均为 SQL NULL。同名顾客按编号区分，不要求行顺序。
knowledge: LEFT JOIN 保留左表所有行；存在匹配时输出匹配组合，不存在匹配时仍输出一行，并把右表列补为 NULL。
本关左表应是 customers；把 orders 放左边只能保留订单，不能表示完全没有订单的顾客。
右表 orders.id 在原表不为空，但外连接生成的未匹配行可以让它变成 NULL。这是连接结果的空值，不是夹具中存在坏编号。
不要用 DISTINCT 合并顾客的多张订单；左连接保证保留左行，并不保证每个顾客恰好只有一行。
starterSql: -- 保留所有顾客，为没有订单的顾客显示未匹配的 NULL。

hints.text: 确定哪个实体即使没有匹配也必须出现，把它放左边。
FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o，ON 仍沿 customer_id 外键。
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.id AS order_id, o.status FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.id AS order_id, o.status FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 顾客 6 没有订单，所以出现一行右侧 NULL；顾客 4 的已取消订单仍是真实匹配，本关不能删掉。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.id AS order_id, o.status FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id;
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.id AS order_id, o.status FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id;
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, COALESCE(o.id, 0) AS order_id, o.status FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id;

flowchart.exampleSql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.id AS order_id, o.status FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id;

nodes.label: 左侧：所有顾客
nodes.description: 以 customers 为保留侧，顾客按 id 区分，而不是按姓名合并。

nodes.label: ON：匹配订单顾客编号
nodes.description: 查找 c.id = o.customer_id 的订单；同一顾客可以匹配多张订单。

nodes.label: LEFT JOIN：保留匹配或未匹配行
nodes.description: 有匹配时每张订单形成一行；无匹配时仍保留顾客，右表列补为 NULL。

nodes.label: SELECT：输出四列
nodes.description: 取顾客编号、姓名与右侧订单编号、状态；本例不筛选状态，也不保证行顺序。
